recap.headline: WEEK 10 RECAP 🚨 Four teams at 6–4, two at 5–5, four at 4–6. Every team is within two games of first with four weeks left, and the trade deadline is THIS WEEK. Act accordingly 📞

featured.hook: I AM A MAN OF MY WORD 🫡
featured.body: In Week 1, I said we were going to force this tank on Adi whether he likes it or not. In Week 10, Adi posted his best score of the season, 151.36, and lost by 19.58 anyway 😭 Sleeper had me losing by 3.0. Gibbs said no thank you: 252 scrimmage yards, the most by anyone in this league all season. Mahomes, my 12:40 AM trade, threw FIVE touchdowns. Likely added 27.7, and Myles Price, who I grabbed off the wire Sunday morning, caught a touchdown 🧠 Love at first Dart has Love AND Dart on IR and still dropped 170.94. Four of five rematches flipped this week; mine was the only one that didn't. Adi has gone 0–2, won four straight, and lost four straight. The prayers have been left on read 📵 Back in a playoff spot at 5–5. Commissioner plot armor remains undefeated 🛡️

Andrew started the season 0–3 with a team literally called Free Wins. He's 6–1 since, with four straight wins, and had TOM BRADY on his roster since Week 1. George Pickens gave him 4.3 against Mateo in Week 1. In the rematch: 11 catches, 145 yards, THREE touchdowns, 38 points,  Mateo lost with Mark Andrews catching 8 of 8 for 16.2 ON THE BENCH while Brock Bowers started and caught two for 18. Kamara also scored 14.9 on 14 total yards, on the bench behind Etienne's 4.9. Either swap would've won it. The Schedule has now alternated W, L, W, L for eight straight weeks. By that math, Mateo wins next week 📅

Sleeper has made Jit the underdog in all ten games this season. He's 6–4 with five straight wins after beating his coworker Cody 142.90–123.86 (Sleeper had Cody by 17.6). Dak threw five touchdowns. Jalen Coker, who dropped 29.8 on Jit in Week 1, scored 0.3 in the rematch. "Chosen Juan" Cody falls to sixth and holds the last playoff seat.
